verdict.rationale: Angular's CLI ships a first-party unit test command, and the framework provides Signals for reactive state and dependency injection. A community user also credits DI with easy testing, though that comment is about AngularJS. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents testing signals or services in isolation without rendering components to the DOM. Missing for 10: documentation of DOM-free unit testing of signals/services, a testing guide for reactive state, and independent hands-on corroboration for modern Angular.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit test my reactive state and logic without needing to render the DOM
